summary.text: Kaldheim follows Kaya and the Kannah's Niko Aris across the snowbound realms of Kaldheim, where the devil planeswalker Tibalt, disguised as the god Valki, stirs up chaos.

Using the Sword of the Realms, Tibalt creates a Doomskar before Kaya and Tyvar Kell can take it from him, and Koma attacks Starnheim while thousands of demons led by Varragoth rise against another realm.
In the end Kaya kills Varragoth, and Halvar uses the Sword to seal the Doomskar and close the rifts, though Vorinclex has mortally wounded the goddess Esika.
